title: Split TUI runtime into shell, parser, view model and dispatch modules
purpose: Reduce tui.rs size and prepare for full-screen shell work without changing current behavior.
scope: Extract typed command parser into a dedicated module.
Extract durable runtime controller and dispatch adapter boundaries.
Extract view model and render helpers into focused modules.
Keep existing public command behavior stable.
acceptance_criteria: No runtime behavior changes are introduced by the split.
Parser, shell, view model and dispatch responsibilities are separately testable.
agentd still does not own planner, resolver, policy or side-effect execution.
Existing TUI tests and replay still pass.
failure_modes: Scripted mode drifts from interactive mode.
Dispatch layer starts encoding runtime policy.
